args.build:
OPTIMISATION PASS on the Fable 5.2 ripple lane (client, 22 Nov ~06:20: "ok, but please please pleaseeeeeeeeeeee make no mistakesss!!!" - after the client paid for Fable and its lane failed two hard gates; this pass must make that look shippable). Context: the client's #1 priority is the ripple area under the sculpture ("prio, ensure bagian ini sama kaya di design, gini yaa, color dan reflectionnya"; target MAIN/notes/round11/refs_user/ripple_target_2026-11-21.png; Cycles GT $SP/work_p4/rip2_gt/). MAIN now ships lane A (round 2, LANES/p4rxa, lab :5175: cobalt troughs + cyan glint, passes every gate; scores env 8.3, grade 8.5, awwwards 7.8, hold 7.6). Fable's lane (LANES/p4rxf, lab :5177, Water.ts 69ca1991...) has the look closest to the design (awwwards 7.9, zone mean ~160-165 vs target 157, cyan-white px ~2000-2300 vs 3180) but its re-judge FAILED two hard gates: read MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4pri3/rejudge_p4rxf/LOG.md (verdict + RXF-RJ1..7), judge_p4rxf/LOG.md, the lane's HANDOFF.md and $SP/work_p4/p4rxf/LOG.md first.
YOUR LANE: LANES/p4rxo (an exact clone of p4rxf's final; serve it on :5178). Switch: ?p4rxf=0 (inherited) must still restore :5173 (int3_base) exactly.
SCOPE (engineering only, NO look redesign; keep the look within tolerance of p4rxf's final at the target zoom: troughs, zone mean, cyan-white px within ~10 %, the same band layout):
1. PERF (blocker RXF-RJ2): the real-loop AdaptiveScale governor must HOLD render scale 1.0 (probe: real loop, no ?scale, >= 3 trials of >= 20 s; :5173 holds 1.0), and at equal scale rest AND pointer-sweep medians <= +5 % vs :5173 (int2's perfab.mjs, 6 VALID STRICT pairs, SLOT_BG=0, load < 10). Lead's lead: the cost is the tilt's height marches (three per pixel; rxfWaveGrad3 shares one march of ~32 samples). The crest train is ANALYTIC (z = 0.226 exp(-(2.362 a)^2), 2.717 m apart, known speed): consider band-limiting it analytically instead of marching - e.g. widen each Gaussian crest by the pixel's world-space footprint (variance add) so the mean tilt over the pixel comes in closed form, killing the silhouette dash that the marches were averaging away; or fewer samples with a footprint-aware step. Measure (c) sparkle after every perf change.
2. WATERLINE (blocker RXF-RJ1): the FAIR gate ($SP/work_p4/gt_new/tools/gt.sh + fair.sh; lane vs its OWN 16-sample GT) must be <= int3_base's own + 10 % on ALL six paths (bars: slow 45, medium 80, fast 68, diag 43, reverse 112, leave 59). What is left is edge aliasing at the bottom rocks' occlusion edges; the re-judge suggests a WORLD-SPACE fade near solids (distance to the nearest solid in the lake plane, e.g. from the static height / shore data the calm already uses) rather than the mirror target's alpha.
3. Minors if they fall out cheaply: RXF-RJ3 soft steps under the right floe at DPR2; RXF-RJ4's flat cobalt slab next to the bottom-right rock in motion; RXF-RJ7 sub-threshold shimmer. Leave look items (bullseye, wavier bands, finer glitter, F000-vs-crop darkness) alone.
HARD GATES on the FINAL build (numbers in HANDOFF): (a) ?p4rxf=0 == :5173 (ident T1, T2, T0 phone, p04/p06/p07); (b) the fair gate on all six paths as above, worst events looked at at 3-4x; (c) 60 fps sparkle excess <= :5173's (lane 1x minus its own DPR-2 GT, base likewise; zone / glint / near / rocks); (d) nothing outside the lake changes; ice rings' look at rest within the refraction residual already accepted (report q00-q03 ring pixels); (e) PERF as in 1 (governor 1.0 AND medians <= +5 %); (f) one ring field press / hold / release, p04-p08 not worse than :5173; (g) tsc clean (both configs), 0 console errors.
DELIVER: sheets TARGET | GT | p4rxf (Fable final) | p4rxo (yours) | A (:5175) | MAIN-old (:5173) at the target zoom (3 clocks) and 1x vs F000, plus 2x glint / band crops, saved also as MAIN/notes/round11/refs_user/rip4_*.jpg; the numbers table; the patch vs LANES/int3_base/retrux-web/app; HANDOFF.md; leave the lab running. ok = true only if EVERY hard gate passes and the look is within tolerance of p4rxf's.
args.judge: LENSES: environment, color_grade_post, awwwards_jury, glitch_hold_sweep. Decide whether the optimised Fable lane (p4rxo, :5178) can REPLACE lane A (now shipped in MAIN; lab :5175) as the ripple: (1) every hard gate passes on its final build (re-run yourself: ident T1, the governor probe (real loop, >= 2 trials, scale must stay 1.0) + one perf A/B rest, the FAIR waterline gate on fast + reverse against the lane's own GT of the FINAL build, 60 fps sparkle excess); (2) at a glance it reads clearly closer to the client's target (MAIN/notes/round11/refs_user/ripple_target_2026-11-21.png) and the Cycles GT ($SP/work_p4/rip2_gt/gt_full.png) than A, with nothing CG / painted / seamed; (3) nothing anywhere in the frame is worse than A (poses, pointer spots, sweep, press / hold / release). Score A (:5175) and the lane from the same images side by side. pass = no blocker / major / minor open.
